edicao: Keep the SAME room and the SAME night as the attached panel: the plain warm cream wall, the window with the crescent moon and the dark-blue night sky, the teal curtain, the warm table lamp glowing on the little wooden cabinet, the same SMALL ROUND side table covered in sage-green felt with its wooden rim, the same pink dice, and the same Diana (white cat, black-tipped ear, grey brow marks, the little bandage with dice pips on the bridge of her nose). Same thick cocoa outline, same flat sticker style, same colors and lighting. No text or letters anywhere. Change only the moment: Diana sits behind the same round table and holds open, with both front paws, an old notebook with a worn green cloth cover; the cover reads 'RECEITAS DA DIANA' in neat hand lettering (these are the only words allowed). Between the pages, ragged stubs where several pages were torn out. Her face peeks over the notebook, looking at the reader. The three pink dice rest on the felt in front of the notebook. The upper-left third of the frame (top 40%) stays empty plain wall, free for a speech balloon.
